intro: Corrupt Manifestation's Bracers are the physical remnants recovered from a tainted water elemental on the coast of Silverpine Forest. Taken by shaman initiates undergoing the Call of Water, they serve as a vital component in an elemental cleansing rite atop the Brazier of Everfount.

p: When the Scourge's plague swept through Lordaeron, it did not spare the natural spirits of the land. Along the misty shores of Silverpine Forest west of the Sepulcher, a once-sacred water shrine fell victim to taint, twisting its resident water manifestation into an aggressive, corrupted shade. Shaman initiates are sent to quell the creature and retrieve its bracers. Combined with purest water upon the Brazier of Everfount, these bindings are cast into the flame to undo the defilement and summon forth an unblemished elemental spirit.
